goal: FG-302: read shows the real rule names of helper-split models; rule static_rules_match_model, known-bad counts_tested_by_keys

components.summary: Checks ownership, reviews architecture and selects checks across explicitly protected component sub-systems.
responsibilities: verify the map against code; name the owners next to an unmapped file; every contract model declares IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors that resolve and conformance(); unbuilt behavior belongs in target models; report model-tree nesting warnings; every model's components come from COMPONENTS, anchors and PARENT, with unrelated map listings warned and ignored for selection; check and lint share one structural rule set (cycles, layer violations) and show the shortest import path; share type-separated responsibility, state and side-effect duplicate-owner rules with the root model; warn when unanchored code writes state that a model covers, honoring global anchors and explicit negative scope; accept an explicit merged model view without changing checks on the ordinary current tree; validate optional exact TESTED_BY parameter selectors against their base test symbol without changing other anchor kinds; count selected test items once by their base function in the component tests facet; report each legacy runner location as an error with its contract-model migration path; never register it for execution

impact selection (depends_on order is irrelevant): retain surviving current and historical tests/models; select contract models by their anchored files and TESTED_BY tests; block missing or ambiguous test commands; select no checks for comment-only edits after normalizing physical newlines; retain the full closure for unchanged and newline-only requests; a changed existing model or model helper also selects every importing model and every ancestor model, without adding their tests; name owning models in REVIEW and impact JSON; expand explicit importing review children of selected model parents to a fixed point; ignore target draft paths before impact analysis, and filter replaced model suggestions without dropping selected tests; treat component parent changes as verification changes and retain still-registered models that explicitly protected the previous sub-system

recognize real Git-removed contracts through the canonical static registry; omit missing retired paths only when current references are gone, preserve surviving parents, importers and their tests, and select same-id replacement paths
review architecture; a cycle debt covers its member set, and a grown cycle stays an error; group more than three unlisted entrypoints per owner and strength without changing severity

rank behavior owners, prioritizing exact symbol definitions; show one system/component/model tree and its Mermaid equivalent; derive purpose, rules, known-bad, code and test facets from static source and map facts without importing user models; count real test functions and subtree bindings, marking nonnested and untested bindings; own the shared structural rules and source-filtered known-bad generator; name an existing target or its invalid-map warning in the current tree header without running checks; compare current and merged target facets from their selected physical model source, show additions, changes and removed-node tombstones with stable identities, and share the same text budget and five-facet details; show what each dependency uses and how much behaviour is explained by a component-subtree model, a matched test name or NOT_MODELED; show declared dependencies and ordered flows in Mermaid, mark flows with no model, and keep these static coverage counts informational; nest optional component parents and roll up subsystem files, tests, dependencies, rules and model facets without changing direct ownership or double-counting global coverage
compare current owner promises with merged target owners and explicit removal intent when checking a target
one owner per entrypoint; external promises are modeled or explained; warn about the retired behavior ledger without reading it
show the requested component within the read budget
read model rules statically from the explorer the model builds
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache
